title: Crypto Trading Signals - May 25, 2026
top_story_headline: Ledn says bitcoin-backed lending could explode into a $1T market within a decade as rising borrower demand unlocks dormant BTC liquidity worldwide
top_story_comment: Ledn's $188M BBB- ABS matters more for the plumbing than the headline TAM: if BTC loans become securitizable, lenders can fund against bond-market demand instead of just customer deposits or proprietary balance sheets. That lowers APRs over time, but it also creates a fresh liquidation channel where a sharp BTC drawdown can hit CeFi loan books, Coinbase/Morpho-style collateral lines, and wrapped-BTC DeFi at once. Post-Celsius/BlockFi, nobody should underwrite this on brand; custody segregation, LTV triggers, proof-of-reserves, and rehypothecation policy are the product.
